top_signals.title: Steam forum ClickFix attacks infect gamers with XMRig cryptominers
top_signals.summary: Steam discussion forums are being abused in ClickFix attacks that pretend to be fixes for game and computer problems but actually infect devices with cryptominers. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
